description: InVision is a design prototyping and collaboration platform. It's known for its prototyping features and design handoff. The free tier is limited (1 active prototype). The Pro plan starts at $7.95/month (billed annually). Users looking for free or cheaper alternatives seek options with similar functionality.
pricing: Free (1 active prototype); Pro $7.95/month (billed annually); Enterprise (custom)

painPoints.problem: Free tier limited to 1 active prototype
Expensive for small teams ($7.95/month per user)

painPoints.impact: Teams struggle to collaborate in real-time

whySwitch: Get free prototyping with unlimited projects

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.reason: Free tier with real-time collaboration, more powerful than InVision
alternatives.description: Figma is the industry-standard UI/UX design tool with real-time collaboration built-in. The free tier includes 3 projects and unlimited collaborators. It's more powerful than InVision in most ways.
alternatives.bestFor: UI/UX designers who want free, cross-platform, real-time collaboration

steps: Export your InVision prototypes (InVision Settings → Export)
Set up real-time collaboration in Figma (invite collaborators)
Rebuild any complex prototypes in Figma
tips: Figma is the best free alternative for most users
Penpot is best if you want 100% open-source and self-hostable

faqs.question: Is there a free alternative to InVision?
faqs.answer: Yes. Figma has a generous free tier. Penpot is 100% free and open-source.

description: Framer is an interactive design and prototyping tool. It's known for its advanced prototyping features (complex animations, code components). The free tier is limited (2 projects, Framer domain). The Pro plan starts at $15/month. Users looking for free interactive prototyping look for alternatives.
pricing: Free (2 projects, Framer domain); Pro $15/month; Enterprise (custom)
whySwitch: Get interactive prototyping for free with more projects

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.reason: Free tier with prototyping, more community support than Framer
alternatives.description: Figma is the industry-standard UI/UX design tool with prototyping features. The free tier includes 3 projects and unlimited collaborators. Much larger community than Framer — easy to find tutorials.
pros: Better prototyping than Framer for most use cases
alternatives.bestFor: UI/UX designers who want free prototyping with massive community support

steps: Export your Framer projects (Framer Settings → Export)
Rebuild any code components using Figma's prototyping features
Test the prototype with your team
tips: Figma is the best free alternative for most users
Penpot is best if you want 100% open-source

faqs.question: Is there a free alternative to Framer?
faqs.answer: Yes. Figma has a generous free tier with prototyping. Penpot is 100% free and open-source.
